summary.whatChanges: Moves `tinyexec` to the pnpm catalog across vitest, e2e tests, and test-utils, loosens the catalog pins for `tinybench` and `tinyexec` to caret ranges, and drops a stale `tinybench@6.1.3` minimum-release-age exclusion. Resolved versions in the lockfile stay unchanged.
behaviorChanges: tinyexec version is now declared once in the workspace catalog instead of pinned per-package
tinybench and tinyexec can resolve to newer minor/patch releases on a fresh install instead of the exact pinned versions
tinybench@6.1.3 is no longer exempted from the minimum release age check
risks: Caret ranges let tinybench/tinyexec drift to newer versions on lockfile refresh, which could introduce untested behavior in benchmarking and process spawning
tinyexec is a runtime dependency of the published vitest package, so the loosened range affects what consumers install
